PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
AI-Driven Product Leader & Former Founder with 8+ years of experience scaling zero-to-one FinTech, Enterprise SaaS,
and Agri-tech ecosystems. Rooted in strong systems-level thinking from a mechanical engineering foundation, I
specialize in architecting complex credit marketplaces and robust data pipelines (RAG architectures, predictive ML,
computer vision) that bridge the gap between Fortune 500 enterprises and “credit-invisible” MSMEs. Adept at driving
localized, inclusive innovation , deploying vernacular NLP agents across Northern and North-Eastern tier-3 markets to
break digital literacy barriers and slash CAC. A strategic operator with a proven track record of solving high-stakes data
bottlenecks, monetizing advanced analytics, and facilitating multimillion-dollar capital flows with zero-friction onboarding.

AI & Machine Learning: RAG Architectures, Small Language Models (SLMs), Predictive ML (XGBoost, Random

FinTech & Domain Expertise: Supply Chain Finance (SCF), Agri-Fintech, Tax Reconciliation (GSTR 2A/2B),

Localization, UX & User Journeys: Multilingual Product Scaling (English, Hindi, Nepali), Conversational AI Agents,

Chatbots.

Director of AI Products | FAI | Jan 2025 – Nov 2025
Helping Fortune 500 clients like McKinsey, AMEX, and Tata reclaim millions in global and domestic tax through intelligent automation.
• Built a Scalable Tax Reconciliation Engine: Directed the development of a multi-tenant B2B/B2C platform with
robust ETL pipelines (RESTful APIs, SFTP, EML parsing) to synchronize GST portal data and SAP ERP ledgers ,
processing ~$0.5B in GSTR 2A/2B datasets for 1,200+ enterprise clients at 100% compliance. Directly enabled
INR 18Cr+ in annual SaaS ARR from enterprise tier subscription upgrades and expanded seat licenses.
• Engineered an Anti-Hallucination Document Extraction Pipeline: Designed an advanced RAG + SLM
architecture to accurately parse complex multi-region hotel invoices, surging extraction accuracy from 70% to 98%
and cutting token compute costs by 40%. Saved ~INR 2.4Cr/year in compute and manual review costs,
directly protecting gross margin on the AI product tier.
• Deployed Event-Driven CRM Automation: Built NLP-triggered autonomous vendor/client follow-up workflows,
reducing end-to-end pipeline TAT by 7 days. Accelerated revenue recognition by ~INR 4Cr/quarter by
unblocking delayed GST data collection that was stalling client billing cycles.
• Launched an Interactive BI Analytics Dashboard: Structured flattened relational data into dynamic GST/VAT
visualization modules with automated reporting for Fortune 500 stakeholders. Drove a 15% increase in product
revenue (~INR 6Cr incremental ARR) by proving ROI and accelerating upsell conversations with CFO-level
buyers.
External Product Consultant | Supermoney | Mar 2024 – Jan 2025

supply chain telemetry with alternative startup cash-flow data. Connected 20,000+ credit-invisible MSMEs and
fast-growing startups to 30+ lenders, facilitating INR 300Cr+ in working capital disbursals. Generated ~INR 3Cr in
platform origination fee revenue (1% average take-rate on facilitated loan volume) within the first 9 months.

10-minute AI decision engine using RAG + distilled SLMs, surging credit decisioning speed by 85% and enabling
same-day disbursals. Reduced per-loan processing cost by ~60%, unlocking ~INR 1.2Cr in annual
operational savings and enabling the team to scale from 200 to 800+ monthly disbursals.
• Built a Predictive Risk Brain for Dynamic Underwriting: Engineered ML models analyzing real-time alternative
data (seasonal FMCG transactions, supply chain signals) to dynamically throttle credit limits (INR 5L–INR 2Cr),
maintaining a sub-1% default rate. Protected ~INR 3Cr in at-risk NPA exposure that would have otherwise
resulted in write-offs on the volatile MSME loan book.
